provider: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) 3D Elevation Program Work Unit Extent Spatial Metadata (WESM)
api_version: One current mutable WESM.gpkg; exact original version unverified until original prefix receipt, separate from version-pinned WESM.csv

request_contract.parameter_rules: One and only one opt-in HTTPS original source GET for the exact USGS-published WESM.gpkg resource at https://rockyweb.usgs.gov/vdelivery/Datasets/Staged/Elevation/metadata/WESM.gpkg. Only literal header Range: bytes=0-65535; Accept-Encoding: identity, no arbitrary caller URL/host/path/query/header/body, no credentials, no retries, no redirects, no HEAD/list/full download/GeoPackage page traversal, no SQLite query of provider bytes. Require original HTTP 206, exact Content-Range bytes 0-65535/<total>, 65536 original bytes, entire advertised original file total between 65536+1 and 1GiB, identity transfer, accepted static application/octet-stream or GeoPackage/SQLite MIME. HTTP 200 must be rejected BEFORE any source body read, and require exact response 65536 bytes before header analysis. No source data persisted.

response_contract.format: Original public WESM.gpkg SQLite/OGC GeoPackage source: only the exact first 65536 bytes, with original source SHA-256 and bounded SQLite database header metadata. No additional SQLite pages, feature tables, polygon records or named work-unit identities.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: USGS WESM GeoPackage is the geographic work-unit representation corresponding to frequently updated USGS WESM metadata. The source is mutable, and an original SQLite/GeoPackage file-header digest or application_id establishes only partial transport and file-structure provenance. It does not verify the entire GeoPackage content, features, valid geometries, spatial reference system, WESM CSV-to-GPKG file-version equivalence, S1M Florida tile overlap, per-cell lidar source lineage, survey era, vertical accuracy, NoData, ground elevation, flood hazard, model fitness or commercial insurers' CAT admission.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: At most one exact anonymous USGS WESM GeoPackage 64KiB Range GET per explicitly triggered research PR workflow, no automated schedule, retries or page/range follow-ups. No provider bytes committed or uploaded to Git, Neon or workflow artifacts. Logs contain public URL, original digest, total advertised byte length, UTC and static SQLite header integers only.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: The publisher says WESM is newly published almost daily. A successful source-original 65536-byte digest and Content-Range will identify one point-in-time prefix, not a complete original GeoPackage SHA or a stable versioned asset. A subsequent changed prefix/total shall fail closed when a digest is pinned; never auto-approve a refreshed source. The previous 2026-11-16 WESM.csv source full SHA-256 a5f56b54f26767311156116b4721d477bf5d7b6069056117127898852d2d1b83 belongs to CSV bytes ONLY, not the GeoPackage.

rights_and_policy.notes: The official USGS 3DEP Spatial Metadata webpage directly links the exact WESM.gpkg on rockyweb, and the USGS National Map downloadable 3DEP data are public domain. This distinct internal source-review scope permits only one transient anonymous 64KiB original GeoPackage prefix request for research metadata, not whole-file acquisition, feature geometry extraction, raw or derivative publication, continuous automated use, or CAT-model consumption. Attribute USGS in downstream research.

expected_evidence: Exact official source URL, one HTTPS GET Range bytes=0-65535, original HTTP 206 and exact Content-Range with source advertised complete file length
Actual original 65536-byte body SHA-256, retrieval UTC, code/contract SHA-256 and original request fingerprint, with no source bytes retained
Strict original SQLite header magic 'SQLite format 3', page-size and GeoPackage application_id 0x47504b47 plus bounded metadata; no provider SQLite original table or geometry parse

notes: A separate original WESM.gpkg object identity from the previously verified WESM.csv at the same source_id. The official provider link and static OGC SQLite GeoPackage header semantics are T0 only until a real exact 64KiB provider result is obtained. No approved model input, no polygons in Git/Neon, and no inference of geographical intersection with Florida S1M tile.
